data.name: Fairuzah
data.gender_notes: Fairuzah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who brings joy and happiness. The name Fairuzah carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fairuzah usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will bring joy and happiness to others, and bring joy and happiness to her own life
data.etymology: Fairuzah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fairuzah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فيروزة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فيروزة يعني اللون الأزرق أو الحجر الكريم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيروزة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ف ي ز' والذي يشير إلى اللون الأزرق أو الفيروزي، وهو نوع من الأحجار الكريمة. يرتبط هذا الاسم بالجمال والسماء الصافية، ويحمل دلالات روحية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فیروزہ
in_urdu.meaning: فیروزہ کا مطلب ہے نیلا رنگ یا قیمتی پتھر
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیروزہ نام عربی جڑ 'ف ي ز' سے نکلا ہے، جو نیلے رنگ یا فیروزئی پتھر کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام خوبصورتی اور صاف آسمان سے منسلک ہے، اور اس کا اسلامی ثقافت میں 심 गہرا روحانی مطلب ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے۔

in_hindi.name: फिरोज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फिरोज़ा का अर्थ है नीला रंग या कीमती पत्थर
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिरोज़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'फ इ ज़' से हुई है, जो नीले रंग या फिरोज़ी पत्थर को संदर्भित करता है। यह नाम सौंदर्य और स्पष्ट आकाश से जुड़ा है, और इसका भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है, जहां यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: فيروزه
in_pashto.meaning: فيروزه د نیلي رنگ یا قیمتي ډبرې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فيروزه نوم د عربي ريښې 'ف ي ز' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د نیلي رنگ یا فيروزئ ډبرې په ګوته کوي. دا نوم د ښکلا او صاف آسمان سره تړلی دی، او په افغان او پښتون دود کې يې ژور روحاني معنا لري.

in_english.name: Fairuzah
in_english.meaning: Fairuzah means blue color or turquoise gemstone
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fairuzah originates from the Arabic root 'ف ي ز' (F-Y-Z), which refers to the color blue or turquoise, a type of precious stone. This name is associated with beauty, clarity, and the sky. It holds spiritual significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing serenity and divine blessings. Historically, turquoise was a valued gemstone in Islamic civilization, used in jewelry and decorative arts. The name Fairuzah is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a connection to natural beauty and spiritual richness.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, the name Fairuzah holds a deep significance as it represents a person who brings joy, positivity, and happiness to those around them. This trait is highly valued in Islamic culture, which emphasizes the importance of maintaining good relationships with family, friends, and the community. A person with the name Fairuzah is seen as a source of joy and a stabilizing influence in relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Fairuzah holds a deeper meaning as it represents a person who strives to bring happiness not just to the world around them but also to their own souls. The Islamic faith teaches that true happiness and fulfillment come from living a life of obedience to Allah and striving to fulfill His commands. Therefore, a person with the name Fairuzah is encouraged to use their abilities to bring joy and happiness not just to themselves and those around them but also to Allah, by living a virtuous life and spreading love and kindness to all beings. Thus, the name Fairuzah can be seen as a reminder to live a life that is pleasing to Allah and brings happiness to both oneself and others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Joy, Happiness" symbolizes The one who brings joy and happiness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fairuzah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of joy, happiness.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fairuzah bint Al-Harith was a poetess and a member of the Banu Tamim tribe in pre-Islamic Arabia. The name Fairuzah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fairuzah was a prominent figure in pre-Islamic Arabian poetry.
